title: Python Backend Engineer
description:
We're seeking a talented Python Backend Developer to build reliable backend services for data-heavy SaaS platforms, integrations, and AI-powered products for clients in the US and Europe. If you enjoy owning backend features from data model to production, we'd love to hear from you!
Core Competence:
- At least 3 years of professional experience in backend development, with strong Python skills and hands-on experience building production applications.
- Strong experience with FastAPI and asynchronous programming; experience with Django or Flask is also relevant.
- Solid knowledge of PostgreSQL, including database design, indexing, migrations, and query optimization.
- Experience building REST APIs and background jobs for production applications.
- Proficiency with Docker, CI/CD, and at least one major cloud platform such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.
- Experience writing automated tests with pytest and following production-quality development practices.
Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience working with LLM APIs, RAG features, or AI-powered applications.
- Knowledge of Celery, Redis, or other queue and background-processing systems.
- Experience with Supabase, multi-tenant SaaS platforms, or role-based access control.
- Experience integrating third-party APIs such as Stripe, HubSpot, Google, or Twilio.
- Upper-intermediate level of English for clear and effective communication in a global team.
What We Offer You:
- Competitive compensation aligned with your skills, experience, and career ambitions.
- An innovative work environment with opportunities to build modern SaaS and AI-powered products and continuously develop your backend expertise.
- Direct communication with clients from the US and Europe and the opportunity to contribute to technical decisions.
- Long-term cooperation with opportunities to move between projects and continue growing with the team.
